source_title: MEK inhibitors for neurofibromatosis type 1 manifestations: Clinical evidence and consensus
claim_text: In the NF106 phase 2 trial of mirdametinib in adolescents and adults (>=16 years) with progressive or symptomatic NF1 plexiform neurofibromas, 8 of 19 participants (42%) had a partial response.
